key_insight: Mamba-QE replaces the Transformer in a generative quantum eigensolver with a selective state space model, enabling linear-complexity operator-sequence processing.
engineering_relevance: The architecture addresses sequence-processing costs in molecular ground-state simulation, though scalability beyond H₂ remains unverified in the abstract.
method: Reformulate ground-state search as discrete quantum-operator sequence generation.
Use a Mamba selective state space model with O(L) sequence-processing complexity.
Condition generation on interatomic distance to predict potential energy surfaces.
evidence_signal: On H₂ across 16 geometries, the abstract reports energy errors below 3×10⁻⁶ Ha relative to Full Configuration Interaction, with zero variational violations.
watch_item: Linear sequence-processing complexity does not establish end-to-end simulation scalability; larger-molecule validation is needed.
paper_title: Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (MQE): A Selective State Space Model for Scalable Ground State Simulations in Quantum Chemistry
